# CLEAN : Construction Cleaning & Window Cleaning

> Window Cleaning, Pressure Washing & Construction Cleans in St. George, UT. CLEAN washes windows, pressure washes driveways and gutters, and does construction cleans on new builds around St. George. Customers say they show up on time, beat other quotes, and get rid of hard water spots.

## Services
- Window cleaning: Inside and out, screens too, hard water spots taken off.
- Pressure washing: Driveways and gutters washed clean.
- Construction cleans: New builds cleaned top to bottom: dust, sawdust, floors and windows.
- Yearly plans: Sign on for the year and keep the windows spotless.

## Service area
- St. George, UT

## Questions customers ask
- **Can you get hard water spots off?** Customers say yes. One had hard water spots they thought were permanent, and they came off.
- **Do you pressure wash?** Yes. Customers mention driveways and gutters pressure washed.
- **Do you clean new builds?** Yes. One customer had a construction clean after a new build: floors, windows and the little stuff, top to bottom.
- **Do you offer a yearly plan?** One customer signed onto a contract for a year after their windows and screens were cleaned.
- **What areas do you serve?** We serve St. George and surrounding Washington County. Not sure if you're in range? Give us a call.
